「你永远不会看到这一幕。」 diffuses (f38–48, granular hiss) while the crown begins to close
reversed impact flash gathers into the crater (f42–52, snaps off as the drop leaves)
「可物理定律，并不禁止它。」 condenses (f50–58, crisp from f58)
REVERSED PLOP: the crown has closed, the ink re-gathered into a drop LEAPS OUT of the water (contact at f52.5)
punch-in with the drop as it leaps at the lens (f53–57), motion-blurred, strobe ghosts

TAPE-STOP CLUNK at the apex: vertical roll, ◀◀ → ▶ ×0.00, artefacts snap off
held breath: the drop hangs above a perfectly still surface (macro still life, to ~f100)
tape motor starts again (very low; ▶ ×0.00 → ×0.11 by f100, the drop barely moves until ~f108)
the drop falls; fall whistle into the impact, the camera pulls back (f100–121)
「可物理定律，并不禁止它。」 diffuses (f112–124)
IMPACT PLOP (slowed ×0.25: deep, long) + camera shake; flash
impact flash / anamorphic streak; crown jets and micro-spray glitter (to ~f150)
speed ramp up and pull-out reveal of the vortex ring on its stem (f146–196)
card 4 「现实里，它只会散开。」 condenses (soft); 散开 then slowly drifts apart
first Widnall split: the ring breaks into 4 lobes
second split: each lobe into 3 (the ink chandelier)
the bloom breathes alone: long swell to the cut (camera leans in, light blooms up)
peak of the swell on the brightest frame
HARD CUT to black: all sound cuts to room tone
「为什么？」 fades in over room tone (no hit)
为什么 diffuses into grains (very faint granular hiss, f360–384)
only the dot of 「？」 remains at Q_DOT (→ S02)
